ownership.summary: Eufy is a smart-home brand within Shenzhen-listed Anker Innovations Technology Co., Ltd., not an independent listed company. Anker's 2025 annual report describes its smart-innovation business as centered on Eufy, while the group privacy notice explicitly includes Eufy among Anker's brands. At 31 December 2025, founder Yang Meng held 43.40% of Anker Innovations and acted in concert with He Li, who held 3.64%; this shareholder structure belongs to the listed parent, not to a separate Eufy company.

leadership.name: Steven Yang (Yang Meng)
leadership.role: Founder and Chairman of Anker Innovations
leadership.context: Anker's corporate history identifies Yang Meng as founder; the parent-company role should not be mistaken for a separate Eufy legal-entity appointment.

productPortfolio.name: Robot vacuums and automated docks
productPortfolio.positioning: Eufy Clean systems span entry robots, self-emptying models and premium Omni platforms using model-dependent obstacle sensing, roller mopping and dock automation.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires model-level comparison of navigation, carpet behavior, mop architecture, bags, consumables, app region and service.

productPortfolio.name: Robotic lawn care
productPortfolio.positioning: Eufy has extended its home-robotics position from indoor floorcare into automated mowing.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds outdoor installation, positioning, terrain, winter storage and local dealer-service requirements.

productPortfolio.name: Home security
productPortfolio.positioning: Cameras, video doorbells, smart locks, NVR systems and local-storage hubs remain a major part of the Eufy smart-home portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a broader connected-home account but introduces separate privacy, network, subscription and installation checks from cleaning products.

productPortfolio.name: Baby and family-care products
productPortfolio.positioning: Monitors, breast pumps and related family-care devices extend Eufy beyond cleaning and security.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires category-specific compliance, privacy and after-sales programs rather than one universal Eufy offer.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Anker's annual report presents Eufy as part of the parent group's smart-innovation business and describes group-level research, sourcing and international operations.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not treat segment disclosure as the manufacturer record for an exact robot vacuum or security device.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Product labels, declarations and manuals can identify Anker Innovations entities, regional responsible parties and model-specific manufacturers differently.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the legal manufacturer, factory, importer and certification holder to the exact model and destination market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Eufy's app, website and support services operate within Anker's wider digital and regional-entity framework.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the app provider, data controller, contracting seller and warranty entity for the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Eufy sells through official country sites, major ecommerce marketplaces and retail partners in multiple regions.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization, market-specific model suffix and warranty coverage before purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: The Eufy portfolio and product availability differ between country sites, particularly across cleaning, security and emerging outdoor categories.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not assume that a product, app function, accessory or service program transfers between regions.

marketsChannels.evidence: Anker group entities may operate websites and services while a retailer or distributor becomes the invoice seller.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Record the seller, importer, warranty provider and repair route in the purchase documentation.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Eufy benefits from Anker's global ecommerce capability, consumer-electronics execution and a smart-home portfolio that can connect cleaning with security and family-care accounts. Its robot-vacuum challenge is category depth: Roborock, ECOVACS, Dreame and Narwal have moved quickly in navigation, mopping and dock automation, so Eufy must translate parent-company scale into repeated floorcare innovation and dependable regional service.
